svg.text: What the code actually delivers today vs. what is deliberately left open. Nothing below is a hidden bug — the gaps are declared in CLAUDE.md.

g.text: ✔ Discovery: NIO DirectoryStream scan, per-client TX isolation,
*.part/*.tmp/*.partial/*.copying ignored, vanish detection
✔ File stability: pure function, N stable scans + quiet-period gate
✔ Streaming SHA-256 with configurable buffer; stored-hash reuse
✔ Duplicate short-circuit on (client_id, sha256)
✔ Explicit DumpStatus state machine, illegal jumps throw
✔ Bounded worker pool + per-client fair Semaphore + back-pressure
✔ Atomic status-guarded claim UPDATE + @Version optimistic lock
✔ Slow work runs outside any DB transaction (TransactionTemplate)
✔ Exponential backoff with ceiling; retryable vs permanent errors
✔ Crash recovery: StaleRecordReaper + full startup sweep
✔ Windows IO-error classification (IoFailure rule list)
✔ UNC-aware path normalisation (WindowsPaths)
✔ Graceful shutdown drain (SmartLifecycle, high phase)
✔ Startup Oracle .exe validation + 2 Actuator health indicators
✔ REST: /api/status, /api/dumps, POST /api/dumps/{id}/retry
✔ Mock importer writes a realistic Data Pump-style transcript
✔ impdp command construction: discrete args, no cmd.exe,
child-only ORACLE_HOME / TNS_ADMIN, no password logging
✔ 40 automated tests incl. end-to-end PipelineIntegrationTest
✔ Config validated via @ConfigurationProperties + @Validated
▲ OracleDataPumpImporter.importDump() throws
UnsupportedOperationException — no real impdp launch (CLAUDE.md §10)
▲ DumpStagingService — interface only, no implementation (§15–§16)
▲ Credential resolution (database-connection-name → secret
store) is a TODO comment; nothing reads a vault yet
▲ Persistence: ddl-auto: update, no Flyway/Liquibase migrations
▲ H2 file DB is single-writer — multi-instance needs a real RDBMS
even though the claim protocol is already multi-instance-safe
▲ import-timeout config exists but is not enforced (no process
to kill until the real importer lands)
▲ No archive / move / delete of imported dumps (intentional, §23)
▲ H2 web console enabled in the default profile — turn off in prod
▲ Metrics exposed via Actuator, but no Prometheus/Grafana wiring
▲ Lombok is a declared dependency but effectively unused
▲ Real Windows / UNC behaviour is only simulated on macOS/Linux CI;
one WindowsPaths test is skipped off-Windows
▲ No authn/z on the REST endpoints (assumes a trusted network)
▲ Scanner lists a whole directory each cycle — fine for hundreds
of files, revisit for very large directories
